newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest hit by new blast in wave of bombings.
newsitem.headline: Budapest hit by new blast in wave of bombings.

text.p: A bomb damaged an office and shop complex in Budapest in the latest in a series of such attacks in the Hungarian capital, police said on Sunday.

No one was injured, but the explosion on Saturday night damaged the entrance door to a library and to the office of a local group of the Socialist Party (MSZP), which is the ruling coalition's senior member.
Police said in a statement there was no evidence that the explosion was linked to a mushrooming gang war in Budapest.
"According to information (the police) have gathered so far, no link with the earlier attacks can be discovered," the statement said.
At least three people have been killed and almost two dozen car showrooms, restaurants, pubs, nightclubs or peep shows have been damaged in Budapest since September by hand grenades or bombs.
